name: Webull MCP
description: Connects AI clients to your Webull account for real-time market data, balances, positions and order history, and creates order instructions you confirm in Webull.

skills.name: Market Data
skills.description: Gets real-time snapshots, quotes, ticks and historical bars for stocks, options, futures, crypto and event contracts.

skills.name: Accounts and Positions
skills.description: Gets your authorized Webull accounts, balances, buying power and current positions, plus open orders and order history.

skills.name: Fundamentals and News
skills.description: Gets company profiles, analyst ratings, financial statements, SEC filings, insider and 13F data, and US market news.

skills.name: Manage Watchlists
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes Webull watchlists and adds or removes symbols in them.

skills.name: Create Order Instructions
skills.description: Creates stock, option, futures, crypto and algo order instructions that you confirm in the Webull app or desktop before they run.
